proprietors.name: William H. Stow
proprietors.basis: THE TRADE IS THE SOURCE'S; THE HOUSE IS THE INFERENCE. William H. Stow carries dated role(s) of `hotel_keeper` that cover 1835-07-01, graded attested on andreas_1884_v1, drloih_hotels. That the trade was followed at Chicago in window is what the source says; that it was followed in a house of this keeper's own is this record's inference, and it is graded `inferred` for that reason and never promoted. The keeper held no workplace in the business layer before T-1404.

locations.basis: THE KEEPER'S CARD ALREADY PUTS THIS TRADE IN THIS ROOF. hh_stow_william_h carries `works_at: western_hotel` at attested on andreas_1884_v1, drloih_hotels, and that structure's own committed `function` reads `tavern_inn` — the term this trade's premises ruling names. A `works_at` that named a roof of another function would be a BUILT-BY link rather than a workplace and is refused here. The tier is capped at `inferred` because the house itself is an inference: it is the firm, not the roof, that no source prints.

dates.basis: The role's bound is the SOURCE's span and not the house's: nothing says when this shop opened or closed. The record stands on the scene date because the role covers it, and bounds neither end.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read new_york: William H. Stow (new_york). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.
